csharpInspection.decision: CollectOwnedLiteralSourceNames skips independently copyable fixed fields read by NameExpression or FieldAccessExpression. An owned sibling still collects its borrowed root and is rejected.

slgInspection.decision: Owned escape provenance crosses member projections based on contained storage, then tests only the root and destination aggregate for independent fixed copy. Mixed source/destination owners therefore falsely reject a fixed-field copy.

requiredChange: A member projection whose materialized type requires independent fixed copy ends borrowed-owner provenance. Keep owned member projections and all existing move/borrow diagnostics. No index/call/storage admission expansion.
